My dear [Christabel](/person/329)
I think if you told [Warne ](/person/1433)that you had had an offer from [Smith and Elder](/organisation/238) he would be sure to take your story.

The stupid man has just refused Florence Wilford’s dominie and ought to be scarified.[^1] I shall have [Joanna ](/person/1154)and [Fanny Patteson](/person/1154) with me on the 20th, and it is also the time of one of the [lectures](/topic/240), so it will depend on a good many things whether I shall have the pleasant sight of you.
your affectionate

C M Yonge


[^1]: Florence Wilford, Dominie Freylinghausen (London, Mozley 1875).

It ran as a serial in MP ns 13 (January-June 1872).
